name: mochi-repository-quality
description: Pinned repository-level quality gates for the Mochi source tree

scripts.lint: biome lint plugins/mochi-modes plugins/mochi-visuals plugins/mochi-sheets plugins/mochi-documents plugins/mochi-presentations apps/desktop/electron apps/desktop/renderer/src
scripts.format: biome format --write scripts/quality biome.json package.json tsconfig.plugin-contracts.json
scripts.format:check: biome format scripts/quality biome.json package.json tsconfig.plugin-contracts.json
scripts.check: npm run check:dependencies && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck:plugins && npm run test:core-plugins && npm run test:prompt-quality && npm run test:eval-evidence && npm run test:model-transport && npm run test:compaction
